scenario: Fileless In-Memory C2 + Living-off-the-Land (LotL) Execution, Persistence, & Lateral Invocation
summary: On 2026-09-22, user finance_lead on WS-EXEC-02 was compromised via an mshta.exe LOLBin execution invoking hidden PowerShell with an encoded in-memory download cradle (IEX Net.WebClient). The PowerShell session established fileless in-memory C2 to 198.51.100.77:8443 (no binary dropped to disk). The attacker then executed discovery LOLBins (wmic.exe, net.exe, nltest.exe), staged secondary payloads via certutil.exe (-urlcache and -decode), established persistence via schtasks.exe and a Run registry key via reg.exe, and performed remote WMI execution against Domain Controller DC-AUTH-01 (10.20.1.10).
kill_chain: 08:14:10 mshta.exe executed via VBScript protocol handler on WS-EXEC-02 (parent: explorer.exe)
08:14:15 hidden powershell.exe (-NoP -NonI -W Hidden -Enc) spawned by mshta.exe
08:14:18 fileless in-memory C2 connection to 198.51.100.77:8443 by powershell.exe
08:16:02-08:17:30 discovery LOLBins executed: wmic.exe (process list), net.exe (Domain Admins), nltest.exe (domain controllers)
08:22:10 certutil.exe LOLBin download of task.b64 from 198.51.100.77:8080 and decode into update.ps1
08:25:00 schtasks.exe created hourly SYSTEM task MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTaskMachineUA running hidden encoded PowerShell
08:26:30 reg.exe set Run key OneDriveSync pointing to mshta.exe persistence cradle
08:30:10 wmic.exe /node:10.20.1.10 invoked remote process creation against DC-AUTH-01
08:30:45 DC-AUTH-01 WmiPrvSE.exe spawned powershell.exe connecting out to 198.51.100.77:8443
evidence_basis: fileless_memory_execution (encoded PowerShell download cradle, no payload executable on disk)
lateral_movement_wmi (wmic /node:10.20.1.10 invoking remote PowerShell on DC-AUTH-01)
distractors: Normal Chrome, Teams, Outlook, SearchIndexer, and Edge background telemetry across WS-EXEC-02, WS-SALES-02, WS-HR-03, and DC-AUTH-01.
notes: The database contains ONLY a raw single table: events(timestamp, host_id, raw_json). All relational sub-tables (processes, files, network_connections, registry_events, hosts, users) are synthesized on the fly via SQLite in-memory virtual adapter views with zero disk mutation.
